- Minor internal update to bring.py (details not specified).
- No changes to user-facing features or documentation.

- Initial release: manage Bring! shopping lists via CLI using the bring-api Python package.
- Supports adding, removing, completing, and listing items on any Bring! shopping list.
- Easy authentication setup via environment variables or credentials file.
- Includes commands for listing all shopping lists and specifying target lists by name.
- Troubleshooting tips and full usage examples provided in documentation.
